mapper.select: SELECT fo.file_object_id, CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED) AS property_unit_id, fo.bucket_name, fo.object_key, fo.original_name, fo.content_type, fo.size_bytes, fo.sha256, fo.status FROM property_unit p JOIN layout_template_floor_plan ltfp ON ltfp.layout_template_id = p.layout_template_id JOIN file_object fo ON fo.file_object_id = ltfp.file_object_id AND fo.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.property_unit_id = #{propertyUnitId}

SELECT fo.file_object_id, CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED) AS property_unit_id, fo.bucket_name, fo.object_key, fo.original_name, fo.content_type, fo.size_bytes, fo.sha256, fo.status FROM layout_template lt JOIN layout_template_floor_plan ltfp ON ltfp.layout_template_id = lt.layout_template_id JOIN file_object fo ON fo.file_object_id = ltfp.file_object_id AND fo.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE lt.layout_code = #{layoutCode}
SELECT layout_template_id FROM layout_template WHERE layout_code = #{layoutCode}
